title: reconciliation.ledger_break_detected
description: The ledger failed to balance with itself: one asset whose debits and credits disagree, found by the admin role checking the trial balance every thirty seconds. Different from reconciliation.break_detected, which compares the ledger against the chain; this one needs no node and fires when the books themselves are wrong. Edge-triggered: sent when a break appears or its size changes, never for one that merely stays open. The break closes on its own when the asset balances again; GET /admin/v1/reconciliation/breaks shows the current state.

debits.description: Sum of every debit posting of the asset.

credits.description: Sum of every credit posting of the asset.
